purpose: Identity and acquisition record for the OCR weights and Python environments used by the frozen run, published alongside the frozen run package without modifying it.
ocr_weight_acquisition: The two weight files are installed inside the pix2tex package directory (<site-packages>/pix2tex/model/checkpoints/) and are downloaded by pix2tex on first use. They are not redistributed in this package.
ocr_weight_combined_sha256_definition: SHA-256 over the weight files sorted by full path: for each file, update the digest with the file name encoded as UTF-8, then with the hex SHA-256 of the file encoded as ASCII. Implementation: common/formula_kb_production/runtime_fingerprint.py, function combined_sha256().
ocr_weight_combined_sha256_status: Recomputed on the reproduction host with runtime_fingerprint.combined_sha256(checkpoint_files()); identical to the ocr_checkpoint_sha256 recorded by the frozen run in merge_summary.json. The two weight files are not redistributed, so reproducing the value requires a local pix2tex 0.1.4 installation.

host_hardware.cpu: Intel Xeon Platinum 8352V @ 2.10 GHz, 16 vCPU per host
host_hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (24 GB) x 1 per host

gold_recomputation.input: archived OCR text only; OCR was not re-run
gold_recomputation.checks: formula tree, analysis target, machine M-labels, human M-labels

correction_note: Corrected on 2026-11-22: ocr_weight_combined_sha256 now matches the ocr_checkpoint_sha256 recorded by the frozen run in merge_summary.json, recomputed on the reproduction host with runtime_fingerprint.combined_sha256(checkpoint_files()); python_environments records the verified Python 3.10.8 for both hosts. No record, transcription, tree, label or verdict is affected.
data_change_note: Adding this file does not change any record, transcription, tree, label or verdict in the dataset, and does not change the frozen run package.
